# Files from other projects

These files are copied into the app so it loads nothing from other sites.

| File | From | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `chart.umd.min.js` | [Chart.js](https://www.chartjs.org) 4.6.1 | MIT |
| `inter-*.woff2` | [Inter](https://rsms.me/inter/) by Rasmus Andersson, the subsets Google Fonts serves (v20) | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

To update Chart.js: replace the file with the new `dist/chart.umd.min.js` from
the Chart.js release, and check every chart in the app.
